name: Doki Doki Exit Music: Redux
storyline: The main character of this story decides to wake Sayori, instead of going to school with Natsuki's cupcakes and on a particularly horrible night while spying on Natsuki discovers her relationship with her father, worried allows her to stay in his house.
summary: A total rewrite and general overhaul of the 2018 Radiohead-inspired mod, Exit Music. It has been improved on every front, with a story loosely following the events of the original, but rewritten from the ground up to improve the experience, and make for a much more cohesive and enjoyable story. On top of that, the mod retains its Radiohead score (now censor-friendly!), all-new spritework & CGs, alongside a meticulous attention to detail & sound design.
